ModMetaData.name: Overlord Magic (Test Build)
ModMetaData.author: Your Name
ModMetaData.description:
Test build of a tiered magic system. Player-controlled colonists get a "Cast spell" button with 13 sample spells covering every cast type and effect type: damage, heal, summon (beings, objects, self-teleport), creation, and status (buff, debuff, control).
No mana cost and no requirements in this build. No DLC needed. Requires the Harmony mod.
Spells are plain XML (SpellDef), so new ones can be added without touching code.
